tasks.objective: Build the C1/C2 provenance-lineage matrix for the first two Maimonidean contradiction mechanisms, restricted to the first three operational layers extracted from Halikhot Olam. Separate authority, transmission, attribution, position/state, time and textual occurrence. Do not classify later causes.
inputs: Maimonides Guide for the Perplexed first two contradiction causes
acceptance_checks: Every relation has provenance or is explicitly marked CANDIDATE
AUTHorship, TRANSMISSION, ATTRIBUTION, POSITION and TEXT_OCCURRENCE are not conflated
C1 and C2 remain separate mechanisms
No C3+ material is promoted into the current matrix

tasks.objective: Construct family/lineage graphs for who said what, from whom it was received, to whom it was transmitted, which position/state it represents, and where it appears in text. Preserve branches and unresolved attribution.
acceptance_checks: No inferred parent is silently promoted
